subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should the recently adopted current branch be integrated and re-proven as the canonical fix, or should maintainers finish the five-part split series before closing this PR?
rationale: The full PR is proof-positive but conflicting, while the split series currently contains only prerequisites and no viable complete replacement; choosing the landing vehicle determines how broad session-state and compatibility risks are integrated.

options.title: Integrate Current Branch
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts while preserving the reviewed invariants, then require exact merge-result tests and real Gateway proof before landing this PR.

options.title: Finish Split Series
options.body: Keep this PR as the reference until all remaining production wiring and hardening PRs are open, proof-positive, and collectively replace the complete behavior.

options.title: Pause Durable Recovery
options.body: Pause both paths only if maintainers explicitly reject the durable three-attempt quarantine policy despite the reproduced availability failure.

recommendation.title: Integrate Current Branch
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts while preserving the reviewed invariants, then require exact merge-result tests and real Gateway proof before landing this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and authored the latest integration-oriented head commits, making them the best available owner for selecting and completing the landing path.
